- Cover every scoped area purpose, referencing other packet scopes where only part of an area is owned.
- Give sourced correction recommendations and explicit unresolved gaps; create bounded correction/source-restoration followups. Never close source gaps by structure checks or unsupported exceptions.
- Preserve approved outer scopes and coordinate shared parent/source predecessor edits. No geographic or record changes in initial review.
- Two PR budget applies to this evidence packet; if new work exceeds it split bounded children. Completion of initial review does not certify the regional branch or enable imports.

Document every source/island, each new coextensive tier exception, all shared original parents, and known omissions. Modern coastline dates are not ancient effective intervals. Source roles and original sovereign affiliations are evidence hints, not approved location ownership or tier suitability. Every sourced correction requires a separate bounded engineering issue. Preserve other workers’ evidence and all archived identities. Do not change shared hierarchy, footprints, canonical grid, UI/schema, claims or live releases. Historical location-attribute imports remain blocked until the complete region is separately approved and published.
